summonPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Summonlab mass-generation wave 1, one-star full-body summon-art candidate. Input images: Image 1 is the sole identity, body, hairstyle, and wardrobe-DNA reference. Image 2 is only the accepted rendering-style and realism-ceiling reference; do not copy its person, braid, clothes, pose, or rank progression. Primary request: Create exactly one 1-star full-body hero based on Image 1, rendered in the cinematic semi-realistic painted game-key-art style of Image 2. Style/medium: cinematic semi-realistic fantasy character painting; believable adult anatomy, weight, skin, hair, cloth, leather, and metal; polished painterly key-art finish with controlled texture and crisp material edges. More grounded than anime, clearly painted rather than photographed. Do not push into literal live-action photography, photo-specific pores or lens effects, plastic 3D rendering, cel shading, or exaggerated anime. Composition/framing: one weaponless adult, full body, neutral three-quarter standing pose, both hands and both feet visible, centered with generous safe margin, consistent head scale, warm pale parchment studio wash and soft grounding shadow. Rank: 1-star—ordinary mortal presentation, practical maintained clothing, simple construction, no supernatural effects, but one memorable identity cue with visible future potential. Expression: calm, controlled, identity-consistent neutral affect; no smile, grin, theatrical anger, glamour expression, or exaggerated acting. Identity invariants: preserve Image 1's recognizable face, age, skin, body type and proportions, hairstyle silhouette, core palette, and wardrobe construction. Do not idealize every body into the same slim athletic shape. Constraints: no printed star, number, label, text, card frame, UI, logo, watermark, weapon, shield, active magic, aura, glow, levitation, affinity effect, crown, full armor suit, extra person, sexualization, cropped limbs, or published-character resemblance. Specific accessory treatment: [per-target detail recorded below].
